description_expanded: Overview5.0(3 reviews)INLET BEACH - Serenity by the Sea Heated Community Pool | Private Elevator | 1 Minute to the Beach | Sleeps 14 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Serenity by the Sea, a stunning 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom home just a 1-minute bike ride to Wall Street Public Beach Access. Perfect for large families or reunions, this luxurious retreat offers spacious living, panoramic Gulf views, and easy access to nearby dining and shopping. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax on covered balconies overlooking the Gulf and the heated community pool, shared with just a few homes and heated seasonally. Walk a few minutes to public beach accesses with beach service, outdoor showers, and restrooms. HOME FEATURES 5 bedrooms | 5 bathrooms | Sleeps 14 Private elevator servicing all floors (adult use only) Game room with foosball, Xbox, board games, and Smart TV Fully equipped kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances Multiple balconies with pool and Gulf views Driveway parking for 3 sedans or 2 oversized vehicles Cable & WiFi with streaming on all TVs Pet friendly (up to 2 dogs, non-aggressive, with approval and fee) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Minutes by bike to Rosemary Beach’s upscale dining and shopping 6-minute walk to 30Avenues with dining options including Amici 30A Italian Kitchen Fireplace in the main living area for cozy family meals Concierge services available for beach chair rentals, grocery delivery, and more WHY STAY HERE? Ideal for large groups and reunions Luxurious, spacious living with stunning Gulf views Quick access to beaches, pools, dining, and local attractions SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS Five King suites, each with ensuite baths and Smart TVs Two queen sleeper sofas on the 2nd and 4th floors Serenity by the Sea offers a perfect blend of relaxation, convenience, and luxury for your next beach vacation!Show less
